{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data sentinel)
df_filtered = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = df_filtered['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the result
print(mean_age)"}
